status.title: Your place in line

leave.title: Leave the line?
leave.body: You'll lose your place. To come back, you'll need to join again at the end of the line.
leave.failed: Couldn't leave the line. Check your connection and try again.

undoLeave.prompt: Left by mistake? You can still get your place back.
undoLeave.failed: Couldn't put you back in line. If it's been a few minutes, join again.

alert.soundHint: Want a sound when it's your turn? Your phone needs one tap first.
alert.soundOn: Sound alerts are on. Keep this page open.
alert.title: It's your turn

notFound.title: This link has expired
notFound.body: Links stop working 12 hours after a visit ends. Ask staff if you think you're still in line.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load your place in line
loadFailed.body: Check your connection. This page keeps trying.

status.keepOpen: Keep this page open. iPhones don't alert you when it's closed, so check back here.

textAlerts.title: Get a text when it's your turn
textAlerts.failed: You joined, but text alerts are off. Tick the box and try again.
textAlerts.error: Couldn't turn on text alerts. Try again.

phoneVerify.title: Confirm your phone number
phoneVerify.hint: We'll text you a 6-digit code so we know alerts reach you.
phoneVerify.sent: Code sent. It works for 10 minutes.
phoneVerify.invalid: That code didn't work. Check it, or send a new one.
phoneVerify.waiting: Preparing a security check. One moment.

errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.captcha_failed: The security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.sms_unavailable: This business isn't sending texts right now.

push.enable: Alert me when it's my turn
push.on: Alerts are on. We'll notify you when it's your turn, even with this page closed.
push.homeScreen: On iPhone, alerts need this page on your Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, open it from there and tap Alert me. Or keep this page open and check back here.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Keep this page open, or allow notifications in your browser settings.
push.failed: Couldn't turn on alerts. Keep this page open and check back here.
push.prompt: Allow notifications in the browser prompt.
push.slow: Still setting up alerts. This can take up to a minute.
push.timeout: Alerts took too long to turn on. Tap Alert me to try again, or keep this page open and check back here.

message.called: It's your turn. Please go to {{counter}}.
message.calledNoCounter: It's your turn. Please go to the front desk.
message.no_show: We called you but couldn't find you. Ask staff if you're still here.
message.removed: Staff removed you from the line. Ask them if this is a mistake.
message.expired: This visit ended when {{location}} closed for the day.
message.expected: You're booked. Check in when you arrive.
message.later: You'll join the line at {{time}}. Until then you can leave from here.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.intro: Pick what we message you about. Nothing else is sent.
alerts.saveFailed: Couldn't save that change. Your alerts are as they were.
alerts.calledOffWarning: Without this one you won't be told when it's your turn. Keep this page open and watch for your ticket.

trigger.no_show_warning: My place is about to be given away

telegram.opened: Telegram is open. Tap Start there and you'll get your updates in that chat. Send /stop any time to stop them.
telegram.unavailable: Telegram updates aren't available right now. Keep this page open and check back here.

pos.paid: Thank you. Your payment went through.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Your last position is still shown. It updates when you reconnect.
